references.text: Here the instruction is given to hang the curtain under the hooks and place the ark of the testimony behind the curtain. Exodus 40:21 describes the fulfillment of this command.
Moses is told to put the testimony into the ark. The ark is called the 'ark of the testimony' because it contains the tablets of the law.
The Lord's command to Moses to place the ark of the testimony and cover it with the curtain. Verse 21 shows that Moses did this exactly as the Lord commanded.
The ark with its poles, the mercy seat, and the covering curtain are mentioned as parts of the tabernacle equipment.
The curtain is used to cover the ark of the testimony when the camp breaks up, showing the function of the curtains as protection for the ark.
Hebrews refers to the second curtain and the ark of the covenant in the Most Holy Place, pointing to the arrangement of the tabernacle that Moses carried out.
The curtain is mentioned as what separates the holy place from the Most Holy Place, where our hope enters like an anchor.
Both verses illustrate absolute obedience in handling holy objects according to God's exact command.
Complementary descriptions of how both the inner holy room and the outer altar were consecrated following the same divine instruction.
